page.overview:
Who is Fawn?

The fawn is a young deer that appears in the episode "The Tower." She rides a brick of earth up to the top of the tower Finn is building and, terrified, immediately begins climbing back down. Jake later witnesses her finally reaching the ground at night, and they eat spaghetti together. She runs away when Finn returns to Jake from building his tower.
